_INSTRUCTIONS: Return ONE JSON object with exactly these keys. For each: {value, status, source_url, notes}. status is one of verified | verify_recommended | serve_live | agreed_stable. DEFAULT TO verify_recommended. Mark verified ONLY if source_url is an OFFICIAL source you actually opened. If you cannot source a value, return null and list the key in _open_questions. Do NOT estimate. Do NOT average two sources. For inflation and exchange data prefer TUIK (the Turkish statistical institute) and the TCMB (central bank); for bank charges prefer the banks' own published tariff pages. A comparison site, a fintech blog or a travel forum is NOT official.
_CALIBRATION: Track record on this project: batch 16 returned 1/1 and 4/5 verified-with-official-source; batch 17 3/3 and 3/3; batch 18 6/6 and 7/7 with both models locating the governing regulation itself; batch 19 3/3 and 8/8. That is the standard. Before these prompts were hardened, a Thailand panel marked 24 of 40 verified with only 2 officially sourced and all 22 others were downgraded.
_WHY_THIS_LOOKS_ODD: This asks for COMPONENTS and no recommendations on purpose. The articles report mechanics; the paid guide makes the calls. Do not add advice, rankings or 'you should' framing to any notes field.

money.turkish_atm_fee._want: The charge a Turkish bank levies on a foreign card cash withdrawal, and whether it differs between major Turkish banks.

money.atm_fee_by_network._want: Whether the Turkish ATM charge differs by card network (Visa vs Mastercard) on the same machine.

money.home_bank_fee_structure._want: The typical structure of a US bank's foreign ATM charge: fixed fee, percentage, or both.

money.fx_margin._want: How the foreign exchange margin on a card withdrawal is applied and by whom, separate from any fee.

money.withdrawal_limits._want: Per-withdrawal and per-day cash limits at Turkish ATMs for foreign cards.

money.dcc_mechanism._want: How dynamic currency conversion is presented at Turkish ATMs and card terminals, and who sets the rate used.

money.card_acceptance_sectors._want: Where card payment is reliably accepted in Turkey and where it is not.

money.cash_only_contexts._want: The settings a visitor meets where cash is required.

money.regional_card_variation._want: How card acceptance varies between major cities, resort areas and smaller towns.

money.contactless_availability._want: Contactless and mobile payment availability in Turkey.

money.card_decline_causes._want: Common causes of a foreign card being declined in Turkey.

money.inflation_rate_recent._want: Turkey's consumer price inflation over a recent stated period, from the official statistics agency.

money.repricing_frequency._want: How frequently consumer prices are revised in practice in a high-inflation environment.

money.foreign_currency_pricing._want: Which goods or services are lawfully priced in foreign currency in Turkey and which must be in lira.

money.exchange_rate_recent._want: The lira's movement against the US dollar over a recent stated period.

money.exchange_offices._want: How Turkish exchange offices (doviz burosu) operate, how the spread is presented, and whether commission is charged.

money.bank_counter_exchange._want: What a Turkish bank counter requires to exchange currency for a foreigner.

money.airport_vs_city_exchange._want: The structural difference between airport and city exchange rates.

money.currency_import_declaration._want: Rules on bringing foreign currency into Turkey and any declaration threshold.

money.leftover_lira._want: Rules or practicalities on converting or exporting leftover Turkish lira.

money.fraud_hold_triggers._want: What typically triggers a fraud hold on a foreign card used in Turkey.

money.travel_notice_relevance._want: Whether advance travel notice to a card issuer is still required or effective.
